input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure the volume of air V_lab served by /habitat/lab/eclss/scrubber-1-v4 as V = Qe * tau, from a short CO2 rise at the speed floor then a decay at full speed, the two lab occupants being the source.

steps.why: Rise: scrubber at the 30 percent floor (Qe 0.3 m3/min). The previous test rose about 48 ppm/min; worst case about 90 ppm/min gives +720 ppm, so from 1550 ppm the peak stays under 2300 ppm. Hatch closed and held closed. Start only if CO2 read at or below 1700 ppm.
Decay: full speed (Qe 1 m3/min), record the fall towards C_eq. With V probably 5 to 20 m3, tau = V/Qe is 5 to 20 min, so 30 min spans 1.5 to 6 tau. Hatch unchanged.

monitoring.reason: The two lab occupants breathe the air whose CO2 is raised by the test; hab-b occupants are not exposed with the hatch closed.

abort.when: the device refuses a step's command
a monitored person out of band, monitoring lost, or one more person in the lab

expected.rise: From about 1550 ppm (must read at or below 1700 before start), 2 occupants (0.76 L/min CO2 total), scrubber at 30 percent: CO2 rises about 25 to 50 ppm/min, i.e. +200 to +400 ppm over 8 min, peak under 2300 ppm and under the 2600 working limit. A rise far below noise or a drop would show exchange through the hatch or a wrong source; a rise above 90 ppm/min would show V below 10 m3 or a larger source, and the 2900 abort stops it.
expected.decay: At full speed CO2 falls towards C_eq (about G/Qe = 760 ppm above the scrubber-free baseline) with tau = V/Qe, probably 5 to 20 min (plus 3.33 min scrubber lag, ignored after the first ~10 min). Fit C(t)=C_eq+(C0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau); V_lab = Qe*tau, expected 10 to 200 m3 bound, likely about 10 to 20 m3.
expected.refutation: A fitted C_eq far from G/Qe, non-exponential residuals, or hab-b CO2 (co2-2-v4) moving in step with the lab (it moved only 900 to 960 ppm in the last test) would show the lab is not one closed well-mixed zone and V would be biased.

hypotheses: Lab air is one well-mixed zone.

Exchange through the closed hatch to hab-b is not measured; it is a hypothesis (station-topology gives a design inter-module ventilation of 3 m3/min hatch closed), not assumed zero; hab-b CO2 is recorded to reveal it.
Occupants' number and activity (awake, 0.38 L/min each) are constant during the test; no one enters or leaves.
Effective flow at full speed Qe = 1 m3/min per datasheet scales linearly with speed; the lag 3.33 min is ignored in the fit after the first ~10 min of each step.
Sensor co2-1-v4 is accurate and its noise is small against the expected swing.
